artworks.title: Plate Number 773. Ostrich running
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ostrich in motion. The image is a sequence of multiple frames capturing the ostrich as it moves through different phases of its gait. The layout consists of several rows and columns, each showing a slightly different position of the ostrich, effectively demonstrating a detailed study of its movement. The photographs are in black and white. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Plate Number 774. Adjutant walking
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a series of twelve black and white frames showing a bird walking across a dirt ground. The frames capture the bird's movement in various stages of its stride against a background of vertical lines. The frames are arranged in four rows and three columns, depicting the bird's gait with each step clearly defined. The images focus on the lift and placement of the legs, as well as the movements of the wings and head. The series showcases the elegance and complexity of the bird's walk, emphasizing the grace and natural mechanics of its motion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 775.  Adjutant, flying run
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a series of black-and-white images arranged in a grid formation. The images depict a bird in various stages of flapping its wings. The background shows a consistent, slightly blurred vertical line pattern. The focus is on the bird's movement as it spreads its wings and moves across the ground.

artworks.title: Plate Number 776. Storks, swans, etc.
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a group of birds interacting in a water setting. The image is a composite of multiple frames, depicting various waterfowl, including swans and cranes, situated in a shallow pond or lake with a backdrop of fencing. Each frame captures different moments of the birds swimming, standing, or interacting with their reflections on the water's surface. The black and white tones provide a classic aesthetic that accentuates the contrast between the birds and their environment. The composition suggests a study of the birds' movements and behaviors over time.

artworks.title: Plate Number 777. Storks, swans, etc.
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a series of images depicting birds. The photograph shows multiple smaller frames arranged in a grid, each capturing different moments of birds near a water body. Some birds are walking, some are flapping their wings, and a few are standing still. The sequence gives a sense of motion and progression, like a film-strip effect, showcasing the birds' interactions in a natural setting by water with fencing in the background.

artworks.title: Plate Number 778. Storks, swans, etc.
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white photographic sequence showing cranes in motion. The image is divided into three rows and several columns capturing different moments of the birds interacting with each other. In the top row, cranes are near a wire fence. The second row shows cranes moving and flapping their wings. The bottom row displays cranes in motion, walking or preparing to take off, with feathers ruffled and wings partially extended. The image likely aims to study the anatomy and motion of birds, showcasing the gracefulness and elegance of cranes in their behaviors.

artworks.title: Plate Number 779. Storks, swans, etc.
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a photograph of various birds around a water body. The image is composed of multiple smaller photographs grouped in a sequence, capturing birds engaging in behaviors near and within a pond. Each smaller photograph highlights different angles and activities of the birds, including swimming, feeding, and resting by the water's edge. The setting appears to be a naturalistic enclosure or managed wildlife area with a backdrop of trees and shrubs. The use of black and white tones adds to the timeless and documentary nature of the capture.

artworks.title: Plate Number 780. Storks, swans, etc.
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a photograph of birds gathered around a water body. The image is divided into a sequence of twelve black and white frames, each depicting various waterfowl and cranes congregated by a pond. Some birds are wading in the water, while others are on the sandy bank. The background reveals a fabric or tarp draped behind the birds. The images capture different moments as the birds interact with each other. The scene displays birds standing still or in motion, spreading their wings or searching for food in the shallow water.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.artist: Frank Chauvassaigne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a canyon scene with rugged rock formations, trees, and a body of water. The horizon is not visible due to the surroundings. The image appears smooth without visible brushstrokes, suggesting it is a photograph. The color palette is mostly sepia-toned, creating an earthy quality. A large rock formation dominates the left side, while trees line the middle section. In the distance, the canyon narrows and slopes upward. The water reflects the landscape.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.artist: Frank Chauvassaigne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image features a dirt road curving to the left between tall rocky cliffs. The horizon is hidden by cliffs and slopes, with rugged terrain and sparse vegetation visible. A prominent rock formation with a peak stands out in the composition. The sepia-toned color scheme enhances the texture and detail of the rocks and road, creating an antique effect. The natural elements form a visually striking landscape scene.

artworks.title: Zeichnungen nach dem gemeinen Volke besonders Der Kaufruf in Wien / Etudes prises dans le bas peuple et principalement Les cris de Vienne (Cries of Vienna)
artworks.artist: Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraved title page on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for an illustrated work. The page features ornate calligraphy in German and French, with decorative borders. The German text mentions "Zeichnungen nach dem gemeinen Volke besonders Der Kaufruf in Wien" and the French text states "Études prises dans le bas peuple et principalement Les Cris de Vienne." The year mentioned at the bottom is 1775. The border around the text is intricate, with alternating dashed and solid lines, along with small decorative motifs. The overall style is characteristic of 18th-century European printmaking and typography.

artworks.title: Betenkrämer / Marchand de Chapelets (Rosary Peddler)
artworks.artist: Carl Conti, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, slightly turned to their right. The person has pronounced facial features with a prominent nose and short hair. They are dressed in a long robe with a sash and sturdy footwear. They hold a basket filled with rosaries, some with crosses attached, with a cloth draped over the edge of the basket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Hasenbalgkrämerinn/Revendeuse de peaux de Lièvres (Seller of Hares' Skins)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile walking to the right. She carries a large bundle on her back securely fastened with a strap. The woman has distinct facial features, wears a head wrap, long-sleeved blouse, skirt, and sturdy shoes. She holds a hat in her right hand. A small dog walks beside her towards the front. The background is plain, focusing on the woman and her load.

artworks.title: Bürstenkrämer/Vendeur de Brosses (Brush Seller)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing and facing slightly to the left. They wear a wide-brimmed hat and a cape draped over their shoulders. The person's garment is adorned with numerous brushes or similar objects across the front and falling down. They have a mustache and long hair flowing from under the hat. The person wears knee-high boots and holds a bundle of brushes and a small broom in their left hand. The background is plain, and the ground is uneven.

artworks.title: Huterinn/Vendeuse de Chapeaux. (Hat Seller)
artworks.artist: Sebastian Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a person standing upright. The person is facing slightly to the right, extending their left arm outwards. Their facial features are delicately detailed, with a composed expression and their hair is neatly styled under a stack of hats. The person is dressed in a long, flowing dress with a tied waist and ruffled detailing around the neckline. Their right hand is holding a bundle of fabric or additional hats against their body. The background is plain with a drawn border, and the ground beneath them is lightly textured. There are no other objects or elements in the background.

artworks.title: Kroat mit Leinwand (Linen Merchant)
artworks.artist: J. Feigel, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. His head faces the viewer with a serious expression. He has shoulder-length wavy hair, a broad nose, and deep-set eyes. He is dressed in layered historical attire with a coat, tunic, belt, and boots. In his hands, he holds a hat and a bundle of cloth. The background includes wooden boards, stones on the ground, and lacks atmospheric detail. The man is the main focus of the composition.

artworks.title: Blumenstraussmädchen (Flower Seller)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their back towards the viewer. The person is holding a bouquet of flowers in each hand, with arms outstretched to the sides. They are wearing a long dress with puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice, an apron tied at the waist, and a bonnet tied in a ribbon at the back of their hair. The person's facial features are not visible. There are scattered flowers on the ground around the person, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Perspektivhändler (Telescope Seller)
artworks.artist: Carl Schütz, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing on one foot, with the other foot resting on a boulder. The person is adjusting a hat with their left hand and is wearing a detailed coat, knee-length breeches, and holding a basket filled with items in their left hand. In their right hand, they hold telescopes. Various objects like spectacles and geometric tools are scattered underfoot, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Kupferstichhändler (Print Seller)
artworks.artist: Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his right foot forward and slightly turned to his right. He has distinct facial features with medium-length wavy hair extending from beneath a wide, brimmed hat. He is dressed in historical attire, holding a rolled-up paper in his right hand and a large framed image in his left arm. The framed image contains a detailed scene with multiple figures. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Kroatinn mit Zweibel (Onion Seller)
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on the ground with legs extended outward and leaning on their left arm for support. The person's head is covered with a wrap, and they have delicate facial features. They are dressed in a long dress or skirt, a jacket, and practical footwear. The person is holding a chain of onions in their right hand, with more onions scattered around them on the ground and in a sack beside them. The background is a plain, unadorned surface.

artworks.title: Vögelträmer (Bird Vendor)
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his body slightly turned to the right. He has one arm resting on a birdcage and the other on his knee. The man appears to have a slight smile, a prominent nose, and eyes looking downward. He has shaggy, shoulder-length hair and is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with wide cuffs, a loose coat, and trousers that bunch at the knees. Multiple birdcages surround him, some empty and one containing a bird on a perch. The background is plain with no unique features, highlighting the man and the birdcages.

artworks.title: Hünerträmer (Poultry Seller)
artworks.artist: Friedrich August Brand, after Johann Christian Brand

artworks.title: Müllerinn (Miller)
artworks.artist: Friedrich August Brand and Catherine Brandinn, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, capturing her upper body down to her waist. She is positioned centrally, facing slightly to her right with a calm expression. The woman has light-colored hair mostly concealed under a cap. She wears a gown with a fitted bodice and long sleeves, the fabric appearing textured and layered. Two large wooden tubs with lids are around her, and next to her, on the ground, rests a wooden stool. The background features a textured surface with an overhead canopy made from planks supported by upright poles.

artworks.title: Tagwerker (Day Laborer)
artworks.artist: Catherine Brandinn and Sebastian Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, facing slightly away from the viewer. The individual has a prominent nose and a thoughtful expression, wearing a dark, wide-brimmed hat. They are dressed in a rustic outfit and hold a large piece of wood across their arms. There is a wooden cart with a large wheel, another piece of wood, and scattered debris nearby in an open area.
